title: La Befana
author: Gene Wolfe
note: conf=0.94; "La Befana" is a standalone short story by Gene Wolfe, first published in Galaxy Science Fiction, January 1973 (v33n04). The ISFDB title record (#51878) lists it as SHORTFICTION / short story with no series affiliation; it was reprinted in anthologies such as Best SF: 1973 / The Year's Best Science Fiction No. 7 (Harrison & Aldiss) and in Wolfe's collection The Island of Doctor Death and Other Stories and Other Stories / Castle of Days. Anthology and collection appearances are not series membership. This ebook is a single-story file with no ISBN.
